Experiment_Info.query: Find the sink in the bathroom

Step_2.description: The robot is in a kitchen area with a stove, range hood, and refrigerator visible. A closed blue double door is on the right. No open door is visible.

Step_3.description: The robot is in a kitchen area with a dining table, chairs, a counter with a backsplash, a range hood, and a refrigerator. No doors are visible. Continuing to rotate left.

Step_4.description: The robot is in a kitchen area with a dining table, chairs, a counter with patterned tiles, a stove, and a refrigerator. No open door is visible.

Step_5.description: The robot is in a kitchen area with a sink, dishwasher, and dining table visible. No doors are currently in view. Continuing to rotate left to search for an open door.

Step_6.description: The robot is in a room resembling a kitchen/living room, with a counter, sink, dishwasher, and a table with chairs. A closed white door is visible on the left. No open door is visible.

An open doorway is visible on the left, leading to an area with a black and white checkered floor. The room beyond the door cannot be confidently identified as the bathroom, so moving forward to get a better view.

Step_14.description: A closed white double door with two handles is centered in the view. The door is not open, preventing passage.

Step_16.description: The robot is facing two closed white doors with circular knobs, with a grey wall visible to the left. No open doorway is visible, so the robot will rotate to search for one.

Step_17.description: A closed white door with a round handle is visible on the right, next to a plain grey wall. No open door is visible, so the robot continues to explore by rotating left.

Step_18.description: The robot is facing a grey wall, with an open doorway visible on the left revealing a room with a black and white checkered floor and a dark blue ceiling. Moving forward to get a clearer view of the room beyond the door.

Step_19.description: The robot is facing a grey wall. An open doorway is visible on the left, revealing a checkered floor and a darker room beyond. Moving forward to get a clearer view of the room beyond the door.

Step_21.description: An open doorway is visible on the left, revealing a room with a towel hanging on a rack and a black and white checkered floor, which is confidently identified as the bathroom.

The door is off-center to the right and not yet close enough to fill the frame, so the robot should move forward to approach it.

Step_26.description: The robot is in a room with brown walls and a black and white checkered floor. A white towel hangs on a rack on the left wall. An open doorway is visible on the right side of the frame, requiring a right rotation to center it.
